name: Hanime1
notes: Test24 is a delivery/runtime recovery release. It keeps the Test23 built-in XPath avatar engine, but fixes the broken in-app updater caused by serialized lazyRule callbacks referencing HanimeBoot without explicitly loading Bootstrap. A new Bootstrap v4 + Shell v4 forces devices below build 20024 onto this release and provides explicit require-based check/update/rollback/reinstall/reset actions.
